positions.description: Web & UI performance evangelist

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Pointsource was acquired by Globant in 2018.

Full stack development for web and mobile applications. 

Additional responsibilities include reviewing and interviewing engineering candidates.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack development for web and mobile applications.

Primarily, MEAN(ish) stack: Angular/Vue, NodeJS, SASS, Foundation, Swagger, Cloudant/CouchDB.  Multi-tier architectures.

Additional responsibilities include reviewing and interviewing engineering candidates.

positions.title: Senior Associate Software Developer
positions.description:
-Development of beta and alpha release of SAS Data Loader for Hadoop.  Stack: JavaScript, Dojo, SASS, and Java Spring mid-tier.  
-Helped establish JavaScript patterns and best practices
-Collaborate with UX/design to implement responsive UI
-Unit testing with Dojo DOH and automated functional testing with Selenium.

positions.title: Associate Systems Developer
positions.description:
-Member of the R&D Data Center Projects and Development team. 
-Development of tools and applications for management of 6000+ R&D build, performance, testing and development systems.
-Full stack development (LAMP stack).  
-Develop tools, applications and design/improve systems/processes.

positions.title: Year Round Technical Intern
positions.description: Worked in R&D Data Center Projects and Development team.  Duties include developing tools and applications for systems and server management.
